description: Request body to submit a producer's change that is not born from a finding (POST /v1/proposals/submit, proposals_routes.py; ADR-168 Amendment 2026-10-10 A1-A7, R1-R5). Crosses the API boundary (ADR-056 D7). CORE re-reads the named general-mode assisted.validate_diff run; the caller's word is never the verdict.

validation_run_id.description: Id of the general-mode assisted.validate_diff run (core.fix_runs) that cleared exactly this patch.

goal.description: What the change does, in the producer's words.

anchor_kind.description: issue | adr | governor_request (a finding goes through the finding lane).

anchor_refs.description: The issue, the ADR, or the governor's decided prompt verbatim.

producer.description: Who wrote the bytes (the git author on commit, A6).

retires.description: Files ('path') or symbols ('path::Name') the change removes; verified against the patch at step 0. Empty means nothing.
